requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: Merged requirement for all security, encryption, audit, and compliance aspects including audit logs, GDPR compliance, and API access controls.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Merged requirement for system uptime, performance, latency, and scalability including dashboard load times, search performance, and report generation.

requirements.title: Sales Dashboard Home Screen
requirements.description: The Sales Dashboard Home Screen displays key performance indicators, a pipeline widget, and an activity feed.

requirements.title: Revenue Forecast
requirements.description: Revenue forecast with AI-driven prediction and confidence intervals

requirements.title: Lead Management Screen
requirements.description: Displays lead list view with columns and lead detail panel

requirements.title: Contact 360° View
requirements.description: Displays full-page contact view with header and tabbed content area

requirements.title: Search Functionality
requirements.description: The Search Functionality allows users to search for leads, contacts, deals, and activities using full-text search with fuzzy matching and highlighting.

requirements.title: Email Integration and Sync
requirements.description: Integration with email services for syncing and logging emails, including Gmail and Outlook.

requirements.title: Lead Capture Web Form
requirements.description: A web form that captures lead information, including name, email, company, and source, and sends it to the Lead Service for processing.

requirements.title: Report Builder Workflow
requirements.description: User navigates to Reports > 'New Report'. Selects primary data source and drags fields into Columns, Rows, Filters, and Values zones. Live preview updates with each change.

requirements.title: Lead Conversion Process
requirements.description: The Lead Conversion Process involves converting a lead to a contact, which includes updating the lead status, creating a new contact, and assigning the contact to a sales rep.

requirements.title: Deal Stage Management Workflow
requirements.description: Deal created in 'Discovery' stage. Rep schedules discovery call and logs call notes. System prompts for BANT fields if incomplete. Rep prepares proposal and moves deal to 'Qualification' stage.
